author: Espinosa & Ortea, 2000

note.en: A tiny polished snail, only a few millimetres long, that lives among sand and rubble and is hardly ever seen without a hand lens. Known here from 8 museum specimen records (Salsa Brava, Puerto Viejo, Punta Mona, Manzanillo, 2000 to 2002).
note.es: Un caracol diminuto y pulido, de pocos milímetros, que vive entre arena y escombro coralino y casi nunca se ve sin una lupa. Conocido aquí por 8 registros de ejemplares de museo (Salsa Brava, Puerto Viejo, Punta Mona, Manzanillo, 2000 a 2002).

evidence: GBIF: 8 specimen records in the region (Salsa Brava, Puerto Viejo, Punta Mona, Manzanillo, 2000 to 2002)

sources.t: GBIF occurrence records (museum specimens), Gandoca to Limón

recWhy: Recorded: GBIF: 8 specimen records in the region (Salsa Brava, Puerto Viejo, Punta Mona, Manzanillo, 2000 to 2002).

marks.en: Small, glossy, smooth, narrow shell with a long slit-like opening.
marks.es: Concha pequena, brillante, lisa y estrecha con abertura larga en forma de ranura.
